newsitem.title: USA: Dole says U.S. media has 'liberal tilt'.
newsitem.headline: Dole says U.S. media has 'liberal tilt'.

text.p: Bob Dole, whose Republican presidential candidacy is trailing Bill Clinton's in the polls, on Monday said the U.S. news media has a "liberal tilt" and said the New York Times favored Democrats.

"Let's face it, I think there's an honest feeling that the media ... there is a little tilt to the left, liberal tilt," Dole said in an interview on CNN's "Inside Politics" program. "I think the American people understand that, I think they consider that when they make a judgement."
He singled out the New York Times, which he said "might as well be a member of the Democratic Party."
"They hammer us on a daily basis," Dole said. "We make a major speech, they bury it back in Section D. They put a front page story that Bob Dole and Jack Kemp didn't get along together."
"... So it's a little frustrating, but it's there, it's not going to change," Dole said.
